scope: Finite glossary coverage and curated additions; concept names and aliases only, not copied definitions or a claim of complete worldwide terminology. Source inventory is independent from the Rust vocabulary macro. Typed parameterized components carry musical values; vocabulary labels alone do not imply executable realization.

sources.title: LilyPond Music Glossary
sources.coverage: All numbered headwords in sections 1 and 4; section 2 duration-name and section 3 pitch-name translation tables are outside this finite headword inventory.
